Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the specific birthplace building, conflating the Vermont site’s mention of the Wilder House (his mother’s childhood home/tavern) with Calvin Coolidge’s actual birthplace (the Coolidge Birthplace/Homestead in Plymouth Notch). This misinterpretation of source details led to an incorrect association, reflecting incomplete verification of the historic site’s components.
